markers.reading: Opening play is at sunset, about six in the evening in mid-October.

evidence.quote: It's about 6 o'clock. The sun is setting.
it's like mid October

time.basis: Spoken clock and sunset; no year or month-day number is spoken.

markers.reading: The party eats, camps in its former prison, sleeps, and wakes rested before sunrise the next day.

evidence.quote: So go ahead and take a long rest.
get your camp set up in the in the room that you were locked away in
And yeah, you you get some sleep.
Get up, pre-dawn light, before the sun fully rises, rested.

duration.basis: Long-rest convention; the source establishes overnight sleep, not an independently measured eight hours.

markers.reading: The rested party wakes at about four in the morning; full dawn is still one and a half to two hours away.

evidence.quote: So say, it's like 4 in the morning, right? You've got an hour and a half, 2 h before full dawn

time.basis: DM explicitly dates the waking scene.

markers.reading: A few minutes after Steampup leaves east as a decoy, its barking begins while the party continues.

evidence.quote: So it heads off as you continue on your path. And a few minutes later you hear barking sound begin.

duration.basis: Narrated interval after departure, distinct from the proposed thirty-minute command.

markers.reading: The remaining stealthy crossing of the vineyard takes about ten more minutes.

evidence.quote: the next 10 min-ish walking across passes fairly uneventfully

markers.reading: Quietly cutting and pushing a way through the hedge takes another ten minutes.

evidence.quote: It takes you maybe another 10 min.

markers.reading: The party spends about ten minutes clearing the dirt over the chapel trapdoor before descending.

evidence.quote: It'll take you sort of 10 min to clear off all the dirt.
As they're clearing off the dirt,
You lift off the trap door like disturbing all the dirt around it, and you can see there's stairs down into the darkness.

duration.basis: Stated clearing estimate is followed by clearing in progress and opening the uncovered trapdoor.

markers.reading: Dilion performs the one-minute Mending on Steampup during Gaudin’s Mage Hand cover-up.

evidence.quote: And oh, yeah, it is. 1 min it is.
You can do mending while he's doing the Mage Hand.
7? Okay.

duration.basis: Stated casting duration, followed by authorization to perform it concurrently and a healing result.

markers.reading: The waiting party hears a minute of silence after the hobgoblin calls to its companion, before the trapdoor opens.

evidence.quote: Then silence for a minute, and then you see the light as the trapdoor lifts.

markers.reading: Loria’s swarm spends a minute spreading dirt and weeds over the crypt entrance before departure.

evidence.quote: By the end—it looks—of them, of the minute with this whole swarm

markers.reading: The party accepts a short rest in the hidden archive before opening the bookcase exit; completion is absent from the recording.

evidence.quote: Hey? Let's do a short rest.
I forgot to resume the recording.

markers.note: No elapsed hour is credited: the surviving text ends at acceptance and resumes after omitted play. The ten-minute break is explicitly real-world table time.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: Mid-October, opening sunset, and the next roughly 4 a.m. are spoken. Year 1748 and October 17–18 come only from YAML.
yamlCheck.explanation: The played overnight establishes one boundary and fits the recorded dates. The archive-break recording gap prevents verifying the complete closing span or rest completion; YAML end is not used to fill it.

limitations: The recording omission acknowledged at u1211 removes the archive rest’s conclusion and subsequent exit/scouting interval; their elapsed time is unavailable.
